component.name: RDP Access Auth
component.summary: Manage authentication for your remote desktop
部署、管理和迁移远程桌面认证服务

description.p: RDP Access Auth adds an HTTPS authentication portal to SakuraFrp remote desktops. It supports passwords, temporary passwords and passkeys.
Detect existing installations, manage local services and migrate older deployments with private backups and health checks.
Populate saved tokens in the local editor and show a configured-password summary with explicit replacement controls.
Align the management interface with the personal website: floating navigation, section layouts, loading transitions and local Lucide icons.
Detect deployment type from the service program and hide migration controls after successful migration or a fresh package deployment.
Fix systemd credential paths during migration and retain failure diagnostics after recovery.
Automatic startup detection, migration with recovery, and native package metadata.
